sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: rules of the road
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The hand-signal pictures on this page are images with no extractable text, so no hand-signal arm position is stated [A03] (verify MO-ROAD-D-HANDSIGNALS).
The school bus paragraph refers to a back-cover graphic and the emergency vehicle paragraph points to a later page for the Move Over Law; neither cross-reference was followed into this section [A02].
The work zone fine paragraph cites its statute; the fine minimums were restated in original words and isolated as dynamic [A01].
Local ordinance powers vary by city and county and are isolated as location-variable.
Statute citations in the chapter were summarized, not copied.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page 26 says the pictures show the correct hand signals for turning and stopping, but the pictures carry no extractable text; the arm position for each signal needs a rendered-page review or another official source before it is taught.
